dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any special treasures?

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: ...Special treasures? Why, of course! We have a panoply of precious pieces... Though if you wish to take one, you're going to have to offer something special in exchange.

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Let me take a look... Ah, yes, as it happens, we're in urgent need of some "North Wind."

dialogues.speaker: Tarno
dialogues.text: Just so! Once you've caught a gust or two, please make your way back here — I'll be eagerly awaiting your return.
